summary: In a frantic real-time phase, players scramble to slap spaceship tiles onto their board before the timer runs out, then fly the resulting ramshackle ship through a gauntlet of card-driven hazards that can rip off engines, cargo, and crew. It's a gleefully chaotic, often hilarious game about building something under pressure and watching it (and your plans) fall apart.
praised: great tension between greed (more cargo) and safety (more armor)
second edition streamlines rules and components nicely
criticised: real-time building can stress out slower or younger players
luck of the draw on hazard cards can feel unfair
one player can spiral into a hopeless wreck with little to do

interaction.kind: shared component scrambling and race-based positional jockeying

scoring.why: final credits from delivered goods minus penalties for lost parts/crew determine the winner, with bonus credits for finishing position

similar: Escape: The Curse of the Temple
